name: fractal-factory
description: Build the Fractal Factory — a meta-level fractal agent system that produces validated fractal orchestrator agent families from domain specifications.

phases.name: Discovery Specialists
phases.description: Pass 1 agents — domain scanning and analysis

phases.name: Planning Specialists
phases.description: Pass 2–3 agents — architecture, roster, routing, tests

phases.name: Execution Specialists
phases.description: Pass 4 agents — writer→reviewer loop, infrastructure generation

phases.name: Verification Specialists
phases.description: Pass 5–6 agents — structural audit, oracle validation, gap hunting

phases.name: Delivery Specialists
phases.description: Pass 7 agents — packaging, documentation, final report

phases.name: Orchestrator & Coordinators
phases.description: Top-level hierarchy — session orchestrator, guide, 5 coordinators

tasks.title: Bootstrap script
tasks.description: Create fractal-factory-bootstrap.sh — seeds .fractal-factory/ directory, progress.json, context.json template, agent working dirs
acceptanceCriteria: Seeds context.json template with default values
Guard: exits early if .fractal-factory/ already exists

tasks.title: Progress.json seed schema
tasks.description: Define the progress.json schema — 7 passes, per-pass status tracking, gapHunting cycle counter, convergence bounds
acceptanceCriteria: Schema covers all 7 passes with status enum
gapHunting section with cycle, maxCycles, convergenceHistory

tasks.title: Context.json schema
tasks.description: Define the context.json schema — domain, target, inputs, options sections
acceptanceCriteria: inputs section: paths to domain-brief, domain-docs, exemplars, invariants, constraints

tasks.title: README
tasks.description: Write the Fractal Factory README — purpose, quick start, architecture overview, input requirements
acceptanceCriteria: Quick-start: bootstrap → fill context.json → invoke guide
Lists all required and optional inputs

tasks.title: Domain model schema
tasks.description: Define domain-model.json schema — the shared artifact populated by discovery specialists
acceptanceCriteria: Invariant schema: id, description, classification, confidence, source

tasks.title: Produced agent schema
tasks.description: Define produced-agent.schema.md — the structural requirements for every agent prompt the factory writes
acceptanceCriteria: Frontmatter requirements: name, description, model, user-invocable
Required sections by agent level (specialist, coordinator, orchestrator)

tasks.title: Domain scanner agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-domain-scanner.agent.md — reads domain-brief + domain-docs, produces initial domain-model.json structure

tasks.title: Invariant extractor agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-invariant-extractor.agent.md — extracts behavioral/structural rules from invariants.md + domain-docs, updates domain-model.json
acceptanceCriteria: Invariant classification: behavioral, structural, quality, workflow

tasks.title: Asset auditor agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-asset-auditor.agent.md — scans existing skills, tools, templates for reuse in the produced system
acceptanceCriteria: Scans shared/skills/, shared/agent-includes/, context.json input paths
Per-asset: name, type, reusability assessment, path

tasks.title: Exemplar analyzer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-exemplar-analyzer.agent.md — analyzes provided exemplar agent families for patterns to replicate
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts: hierarchy patterns, naming conventions, artifact patterns, routing idioms

tasks.title: Pipeline architect agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-pipeline-architect.agent.md — designs the produced system's pipeline (passes, entry/exit conditions, re-entry rules)
acceptanceCriteria: Defines re-entry rules from gap hunting

tasks.title: Artifact designer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-artifact-designer.agent.md — designs shared artifacts, JSON schemas, read-modify-write contracts for the produced system
acceptanceCriteria: Reads architecture.json pipeline for artifact flow
Per-artifact: name, schema, readers, writers, format

tasks.title: Depth analyzer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-depth-analyzer.agent.md — decides per-coordinator whether depth-2 or depth-3 is needed based on complexity metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Writes architecture.json depth section with per-coordinator decisions
Decision criteria: subdomain count, invariant density, cross-cutting concerns
Threshold: >8 specialists or >3 cross-cutting invariants → depth-3

tasks.title: Roster planner agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-roster-planner.agent.md — plans the full agent roster with names, levels, parents, dispatches
acceptanceCriteria: Per-agent: id, name, level, parent, children, resultCodes, artifacts, status

tasks.title: Routing planner agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-routing-planner.agent.md — designs routing tables, re-entry rules, convergence bounds for the produced system
acceptanceCriteria: Reads roster.json for agent hierarchy and result codes
Updates roster.json with routingTable per coordinator/orchestrator
Every child result code maps to an action

tasks.title: Test planner agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-test-planner.agent.md — creates golden test scenarios for the produced agent family
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage: at least one scenario per agent type (specialist, coordinator, orchestrator)
Scenarios: input conditions, expected result codes, expected artifacts
Edge cases: re-entry, blocked agents, convergence limit

tasks.title: Prompt writer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-prompt-writer.agent.md — writes one produced agent prompt per invocation following the universal template
acceptanceCriteria: Reads target agent spec from roster.json by ID
Handles all agent types: specialist, coordinator, orchestrator
Follows the universal agent prompt template
Includes status contract with exact result codes from roster
Includes anti-laziness rules for flagged agents
Interactive tool suppression on all produced prompts

tasks.title: Prompt reviewer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-prompt-reviewer.agent.md — reviews one written prompt against structural checklist and roster spec
acceptanceCriteria: Structural checks: frontmatter, interactive suppression, status contract
Content checks vary by agent level (specialist/coordinator/orchestrator)

tasks.title: Infrastructure writer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-infra-writer.agent.md — generates bootstrap script, artifact schemas, skills, golden tests for the produced system
acceptanceCriteria: Writes golden test files from test-plan.json
All JSON seed files are valid

tasks.title: Checklist validator agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-checklist-validator.agent.md — runs the full validation checklist against all produced agents
acceptanceCriteria: Covers ALL validation checklist categories: structural, routing, artifact, pipeline, anti-laziness, resumability

tasks.title: Audit oracle agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-audit-oracle.agent.md — applies agent-as-function-audit and fractal-workflow-eval perspectives to produced agents
acceptanceCriteria: Applies agent-as-function-audit checks: pure-router, artifact consistency, routing gaps, status drift, contradictions
Applies fractal-workflow-eval checks: data flow, re-entry safety, directive propagation, dead paths, lost context
Per-finding: location, description, severity, suggested fix

tasks.title: Gap hunter agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-gap-hunter.agent.md — adversarial search for missing agents, broken routing, orphan artifacts across 8 categories
acceptanceCriteria: Searches 8 categories: agent coverage, invariant propagation, artifact orphans, routing completeness, schema consistency, test coverage, depth-3 necessity, missing roles
Anti-laziness: methodology required even for zero-result categories

tasks.title: Packager agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-packager.agent.md — assembles output directory at target path, validates completeness
acceptanceCriteria: Copies all produced files to target directory
Validates: every roster agent has a .agent.md file
Validates: every agent has status verified

tasks.title: Documentation writer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-documentation-writer.agent.md — generates architecture doc, user guide, roster reference for the produced system
acceptanceCriteria: Writes architecture.md: pipeline, agent hierarchy, artifact flow, re-entry rules
Writes user-guide.md: quick start, monitoring, troubleshooting
Writes roster.md: full agent table with roles, result codes, artifacts

tasks.title: Report writer agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-report-writer.agent.md — final handoff report with coverage stats, outstanding items, quality metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage statistics from real data (domain, invariant, routing, test)
Quality metrics from verification + audit reports

tasks.title: Session orchestrator agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory.agent.md — top-level pipeline driver, 7-pass routing, progress.json ownership, gap-hunting re-entry
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline routing table covers all 7 passes
Re-entry logic resets correct passes on gap-hunter dirty
Progress recomputation from coordinator status files

tasks.title: Guide agent
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-guide.agent.md — human-facing entry point, context gathering, orchestrator invocation
acceptanceCriteria: Gathers domain info, inputs, target path, constraints from user
MAY use ask_questions (only agent allowed to)

tasks.title: Discovery coordinator
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-discovery-coordinator.agent.md — sequential dispatch of 4 discovery specialists
acceptanceCriteria: Sequential dispatch: scanner → extractor → auditor → analyzer

tasks.title: Planning coordinator
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-planning-coordinator.agent.md — dual-mode (Pass 2 analysis, Pass 3 roster/routing/tests)

tasks.title: Execution coordinator
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-execution-coordinator.agent.md — writer→reviewer loop with 3-retry limit, then infra-writer
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom-up writing order: specialists → coordinators → orchestrator
Writer→reviewer loop with max 3 retries per agent
Blocked agents tracked but don't halt pipeline
Purity rule — no prompt writing or reviewing

tasks.title: Verification coordinator
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-verification-coordinator.agent.md — dual-mode (Pass 5 verify, Pass 6 gap-hunt)
acceptanceCriteria: Result codes: verified, verified-with-issues, converged, gaps-found

tasks.title: Delivery coordinator
tasks.description: Write fractal-factory-delivery-coordinator.agent.md — sequential packager → doc-writer → report-writer

executionOrder.description: README (depends on schemas) + all 4 discovery specialists (depend on domain-model schema)
Pipeline architect (depends on discovery agents being designed)
Artifact designer + depth analyzer (depend on pipeline architect)
Roster planner (depends on artifact designer + depth analyzer)
Test planner + prompt writer + prompt reviewer (depend on roster + routing)
Infrastructure writer + discovery coordinator (depend on planning agents + discovery agents)
Checklist validator + audit oracle + planning coordinator (depend on execution agents + planning agents)
Gap hunter + execution coordinator (depend on verification agents + execution agents)
Packager + verification coordinator (depend on gap hunter + verification agents)
Documentation writer + delivery coordinator (depend on packager + delivery agents)
